SELECT 
    dh.hubregistry AS hub_registry_id,
    (dh.hubutilpct * 100) AS calculated_utilisation_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN (dh.hubutilpct * 100) < 30 THEN 'Underutilized'
        WHEN (dh.hubutilpct * 100) BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 'Moderately Utilized'
        ELSE 'Highly Utilized'
    END AS utilisation_classification
FROM 
    distributionhubs AS dh
JOIN 
    operations AS o ON dh.hubregistry = o.opshubref
ORDER BY 
    calculated_utilisation_value DESC;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    dh.hubregistry AS hub_registry_id,
    (dh.hubutilpct * 100) AS calculated_utilisation_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN (dh.hubutilpct * 100) < 30 THEN 'Underutilized'
        WHEN (dh.hubutilpct * 100) BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 'Moderately Utilized'
        ELSE 'Highly Utilized'
    END AS utilisation_classification
FROM 
    distributionhubs AS dh
JOIN 
    operations AS o ON dh.hubregistry = o.opshubref
ORDER BY 
    calculated_utilisation_value DESC;
